scene_input: four current/past RGBD views and measured TCP/gripper/joints

motion_forecaster.unavailable_history: explicit unavailable, never fabricated or replaced by privileged labels

skill_pretraining.goal_input: first commanded TCP position of the current contiguous expert skill segment, used only for offline goal-conditioned pretraining
skill_pretraining.trajectory_input: optional and explicitly reported; first skill pretraining does not consume trajectories
skill_pretraining.encoder_frozen_during_skill_pretraining: freeze visual/history/classifier; train shared skill embedding table with skill policy
skill_pretraining.command_weighting: each parent has equal mass, each committed expert command run has equal mass within its parent
skill_pretraining.selection: offline validation only, before native VAL and TEST

candidate_pretraining.workspace_bounds: TRAIN action position min/max plus one fixed 5cm margin
candidate_pretraining.imitation_score: expert target choice probability, not task success probability
candidate_pretraining.success_calibration: requires fixed-skill TRAIN rollout outcomes before claiming success probabilities

native_protocol.executor: PhysMani native RRT/RML and gripper through explicit pose adapter
native_protocol.task_strategy: learned skill policy, no legacy phase/qualification strategy underneath
native_protocol.train_gate: new-version CPU contracts and fixed TRAIN development cases audited before native VAL
native_protocol.native_VAL: all 77 original four-task validation parents, each once, no retry
native_protocol.TEST: new frozen protocol release only after VAL audit; original official source sets, no fitting or parameter choice

historical_v1219: preserve STOP and evidence; never resume or overwrite the old namespace
